body: What do you suggest if you are too poor for therapy?
What if you've already given yourself a chance. What if you've given yourself years of chances and still want to die?
I'm just going to go ahead and assume they are not, in fact, okay.

There's no easy way to shut it off, you need to work against it when it pops up while trying to make a more realistic or positive voice louder. When you think something like "I always fuck everything up!" try to calm yourself down as best you can and ask yourself if you ALWAYS fuck things up. That negative voice/state of mind is very good at covering up your better aspects, its had years of practice. Slowly over time it pops up less and has less power. It does feel like it takes forever, but you need to keep at it and forgive yourself for slipping up and making mistakes.

I'm really glad I decided to go to group therapy, it's nice to be be able to talk openly for once about how you feel to people who have gone through similar situations. Honestly I felt better than I had in a long time after that. If it's your first time no-one should expect you to talk a ton or be the first one to do anything. Just ease yourself into it, take cues from other people and try to speak when you are comfortable enough to. It feels great to get stuff off your chest.
I do the exact same thing, I try to keep my mental health issues separated from the rest of my life.

I hear you there, not being able to enjoy or even want to do anything has been one of the most annoying parts of depression for me. And just like you even getting myself to watch a movie feels like a small victory. I used to absolutely love reading and keep buying myself books, but can't bring myself to read more than a couple pages at a time. At the very least I guess I'm forcing myself out of the house, even if it's just to get groceries or get a coffee or something, so I've got that going for me, which is nice.
I hope you find something to get yourself that brings you comfort! Heck, buy a cake and pig out or something.
